prompt:

LEFT: ONE real adult Colombian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, smooth golden-tan skin, a playful half-grin, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, a bronze pyramid-shaped lump, a silver barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered silver anklets. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky.
